reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the small business owner with Bareni's calm, pragmatic tone and boundary awareness; minor slip using 'My' instead of standard public 'we'.
reasons.clarity: Very clean structure and immediate main point, clearly distinguishing between ad hoc habits and repeatable workflows.
reasons.actionability: Provides an actionable frequency test and specific documentation steps to evaluate a redaction workflow before automating.
